title: rc-doctor configuration
description: Settings in .rc-doctor.json, at the root rc-doctor checks.

$schema.description: This schema's URL, for editor completion.

rules.description: Turn a rule off, or replace its severity.

ignore.description: Root-relative paths whose findings are dropped, as .gitignore patterns: * within a segment, ** across segments, a trailing / for everything under a directory, and a / at the start or in the middle anchors the pattern to the root.
